info.name: api
info.description: Booking API local collection. Set url and business_id. QueryRoomCategories -> select room_category_id -> CreateCustomer -> QueryReservations -> CreateBooking -> QueryBooking. Staff fixture: Login -> CreateBusiness -> CreateRoomCategory -> CreateRoom. Optional quantity must be an integer from 1–4 (omission defaults to 1); non-RACING categories accept only 1 or omission. The server resolves category ownership/acronym. RACING assigns distinct machines continuously free for the full interval, ordered by sort order/name/ID, even for quantity 1. Confirmed and unexpired pending bookings block overlaps; adjacent intervals, cancelled bookings and expired holds do not. Insufficient capacity returns 409 before writes. One booking has N reservation rows and one unchanged upfront payment flow. Other categories retain the temporary assignment bypass. The response still temporarily returns payment_url: null. Concurrency protection and atomicity remain deferred. Date reservation queries include overlapping intervals; range queries retain contained intervals. All reservation queries require business_id. Payment flow and alternatives remain as documented on individual requests. Concurrency, atomicity, finalized payment enforcement and late-payment policies are deferred. Do not run alternative payment outcomes on the same booking. No credentials are exported.

Inclusive Asia/Kuala_Lumpur calendar range. Both endpoints are required in YYYY-MM-DD format, and to must be on or after from and before its one-year anniversary. Returns rooms (including unbooked rooms) and bookings with customer_name, customer_phone and matching full reservation intervals. Pending bookings are included only while expire_at is later than the current UTC time. Expired pending holds are excluded; other statuses are unchanged. Returns 400 for partial, mixed, unknown, invalid, reversed or overlong filters.

item.name: Demo payment orders — choose one outcome per booking

request.description: Requires an order_id from a booking payment_url. Returns null if missing. Saves reference_id (internal payment ID) for the optional direct webhook request.

Updates the demo order and invokes the webhook internally. Records payment and confirms booking. Choose one outcome for each fresh booking; duplicate/finalized-outcome enforcement is deferred. This request writes data. Returns booking_id for the customer booking redirect.

Updates the demo order and invokes the webhook internally. Records payment outcome and cancels booking. Choose one outcome for each fresh booking; duplicate/finalized-outcome enforcement is deferred. This request writes data. Returns booking_id for the customer booking redirect.

item.name: Payment webhook — alternative to demo submission

request.description: Direct gateway callback example; status also accepts cancelled/rejected. Resolves payment by reference_id, records outcome, then confirms/cancels booking. Does not update the demo order. Use instead of PUT demo submission for a fresh pending booking, not after it. Unknown payment returns 404. Gateway authentication and duplicate handling are deferred.
Gateway-independent internal payment lookup. Returns id, booking_id and price, or null if missing.

All stored payment rows created within the inclusive Malaysia date range, newest first by created_at then id. Business scope follows the stored booking business_id. A legacy date filter also supports single-day queries.

Replace the complete reservations list for any booking status. Uses stored booking business ownership and current room categories. Preserves booking fields, expiry and payment history. New reservation IDs are generated. Other bookings may conflict. Same-room overlaps within this list return 400; missing/foreign rooms or booking return 404. Replacement is atomic. Offset-free starts use Malaysia time; output is UTC. Returns 200 in the QueryBooking shape. Set room_id to an existing physical room in this booking business.

exec: pm.test("Booking and reservations", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("booking_id")); pm.expect(b.reservations).to.be.an("array").that.is.not.empty; b.reservations.forEach(r => { pm.expect(r).to.have.all.keys("id", "room_id", "room_name", "room_category_id", "room_category_name", "room_category_acronym", "from", "to", "duration"); }); });
